rationale: The assistant correctly identified E17 as a Bosch water-supply/fill-time fault and listed 'Tap not fully open' as the first check, which led the customer straight to the half-closed isolation valve and a confirmed fix with no part needed. Safety boundaries were covered ('Turn off the tap and unplug the machine', towel and bowl for the hose), and the solenoid valve/engineer was only mentioned as a last resort after supply checks. Minor deduction on question quality: it never asked about the recent plumbing work or asked a question at all in the first reply, instead offering a long list (including a bucket test the customer would have refused), though the ordering was sensible and the follow-up test run was well-proportioned.
